STRAT_LIQ_SWEEP_DESC: Swing high or low swept, then a structure shift. Closed candles.
STRAT_LIQ_SWEEP_BUY: Took out the low at {swept}, closed back above, then above {mss}.
STRAT_LIQ_SWEEP_SELL: Took out the high at {swept}, closed back below, then below {mss}.
STRAT_LIQ_SWEEP_WAIT: No fresh sweep and structure shift.
STRAT_NYOPEN_DESC: First close outside the NY opening range (first 30 min after 09:30 NY). 5m-30m.
STRAT_NYOPEN_BUY: First close above NY range high {hi} (low {lo}).
STRAT_NYOPEN_SELL: First close below NY range low {lo} (high {hi}).
STRAT_NYOPEN_WAIT: No first break of the NY opening range yet. Needs 5m-30m chart.
STRAT_EMASTACK_DESC: EMAs 20/50/100/200 newly stacked in order after 10+ candles out of order.
STRAT_EMASTACK_WAIT: EMAs mixed, or the stack formed too long ago.
STRAT_SD_DESC: First retest of a fresh supply or demand zone.
STRAT_SD_BUY: First retest of demand zone {zoneLo}-{zoneHi}; closed back above.
STRAT_SD_SELL: First retest of supply zone {zoneLo}-{zoneHi}; closed back below.
STRAT_SD_BUY_BTC: First retest of demand zone {zoneLo}-{zoneHi}; closed above. BTC agrees.
STRAT_SD_SELL_BTC: First retest of supply zone {zoneLo}-{zoneHi}; closed below. BTC agrees.
STRAT_SD_WAIT_BTC: Zone retested ({zoneLo}-{zoneHi}) but BTC is on the other side of its 50.
STRAT_SD_WAIT: No first retest of a fresh zone.
STRAT_BBSQ_DESC: First close outside the Bollinger Bands after a squeeze.
STRAT_BBSQ_BUY: After {countSqueeze} tight candles, closed above the upper band ({band}).
STRAT_BBSQ_SELL: After {countSqueeze} tight candles, closed below the lower band ({band}).
STRAT_BBSQ_WAIT: No close outside the bands after a squeeze.
STRAT_VWAP_DESC: Close back across the day's VWAP after several closes on the other side.
STRAT_VWAP_BUY: Closed back above VWAP ({vwap}) after {countBars} closes below.
STRAT_VWAP_SELL: Closed back below VWAP ({vwap}) after {countBars} closes above.
STRAT_VWAP_WAIT: No fresh VWAP cross. Needs 1h or finer, 6+ candles into the UTC day.
DRAW_STRUCTURE_LEVELS_CAPTION: Levels from the Channel strategy, not a prediction.
STRAT_CHANNEL_DESC: First close outside a channel whose broken rail has 3+ pivots.
STRAT_CHANNEL_BUY: First close above the falling channel top ({rail}).
STRAT_CHANNEL_SELL: First close below the rising channel bottom ({rail}).
STRAT_CROSS_DESC: The 50 EMA crossing the 200 EMA on a closed candle. Closed candles.
STRAT_CROSS_BUY: The 50 EMA closed above the 200 EMA ({ema50} / {ema200}).
STRAT_CROSS_SELL: The 50 EMA closed below the 200 EMA ({ema50} / {ema200}).
STRAT_CROSS_WAIT: No 50/200 cross on the latest closed candles.
STRAT_FLIP_DESC: A chart level broken by 0.1 ATR, retested 4+ candles later from the other side.
STRAT_FLIP_BUY: Broke above {level}, retested it and closed back above.
STRAT_FLIP_SELL: Broke below {level}, retested it and closed back below.
STRAT_FLIP_WAIT: No retest of a broken level.
STRAT_RANGE_DESC: A touch of a range edge that closes back inside. Range: 30 candles within 4 ATR.
STRAT_RANGE_BUY: Touched the range low {low} and closed back inside.
STRAT_RANGE_SELL: Touched the range high {high} and closed back inside.
STRAT_RANGE_WAIT: No bounce from a range edge.
STRAT_RANGE_WAIT_NONE: No range found: price is not moving inside a narrow band.
STRAT_FVG_DESC: First return into an unfilled gap of at least 0.5 ATR.
STRAT_FVG_BUY: First return into the bullish gap {gapLo}-{gapHi}, closed above its bottom.
STRAT_FVG_SELL: First return into the bearish gap {gapLo}-{gapHi}, closed below its top.
STRAT_FVG_WAIT: No first return into an unfilled gap.
STRAT_FVG_WAIT_NONE: No open gap: every recent gap has been returned to or filled.
STRAT_BOS_FVG_DESC: First return into a gap nothing touched before the break. Built for 5m–15m.
STRAT_BOS_FVG_BUY: Closed above the swing high {bos}; first return into the gap {gapLo}-{gapHi}, closed above its bottom.
STRAT_BOS_FVG_SELL: Closed below the swing low {bos}; first return into the gap {gapLo}-{gapHi}, closed below its top.
STRAT_BOS_FVG_WAIT: No first return into a gap left by a break of structure.
STRAT_TIP_BOS_FVG: Uses closed candles: swing highs and lows and gaps between three candles.
STRAT_SESSION_DESC: A wick through the Asia or London session high or low that closes back inside. 5m-1h.
STRAT_SESSION_BUY: Wicked below the session low {sessionLo} and closed back inside.
STRAT_SESSION_SELL: Wicked above the session high {sessionHi} and closed back inside.
STRAT_SESSION_WAIT: No session sweep right now. Needs 5m-1h.
STRAT_TIP_LIQ_SWEEP: Uses closed candles and their swing highs and lows.
STRAT_TIP_NYOPEN: Uses 5m-30m candles around the 09:30 New York open.
STRAT_TIP_SD: Uses closed candles: a strong move away from a small base.
STRAT_TIP_BBSQ: Uses closing prices and the Bollinger Bands width.
STRAT_TIP_VWAP: Uses candles and volume since 00:00 UTC.
STRAT_TIP_CHANNEL: Uses closed candles: swing points on two rails.
STRAT_TIP_CROSS: Uses closing prices: EMA 50 and EMA 200.
STRAT_TIP_FLIP: Uses closed candles and the chart's support / resistance levels.
STRAT_TIP_RANGE: Uses closed candles: a flat range with 3+ touches on each side.
STRAT_TIP_FVG: Uses closed candles: gaps between three candles.
STRAT_TIP_SESSION: Uses candles of 1h or finer, by UTC hour.
STRAT_SQUEEZE_DESC: Funding and open interest both at an extreme for this coin, then a close through the last swing against the crowd.
STRAT_SQUEEZE_BUY: Shorts paying an extreme rate for this coin (funding {fr}%, OI up {oi}%); closed above {swing}.
STRAT_SQUEEZE_SELL: Longs paying an extreme rate for this coin (funding {fr}%, OI up {oi}%); closed below {swing}.
STRAT_SQUEEZE_WAIT: No extreme funding for this coin with OI rising and a trigger.
STRAT_SQUEEZE_NO_LIVE: Needs live funding and open interest, each with enough history for this coin.
STRAT_CVD_DESC: Heavy one-sided taker flow that price held against, then a close past the last candle's range.
STRAT_CVD_BUY: Heavy selling for {n} candles, price held {low}; closed above {trigger}.
STRAT_CVD_SELL: Heavy buying for {n} candles, price held {high}; closed below {trigger}.
STRAT_CVD_WAIT: No one-sided flow held by price.
STRAT_TIP_SQUEEZE: Uses live funding against its last 90 days, open interest and liquidation estimates; past candles are not marked.
STRAT_CHANNEL_WAIT: No close outside a channel yet.
STRAT_CHANNEL_WAIT_NONE: No channel found on the last candles.
STRAT_RSIDIV_DESC: Price and RSI disagree, then a candle confirms.
STRAT_RSIDIV_WAIT: No RSI divergence with a fresh trigger.

ABOUT_WHAT_THIS_IS_BODY: A crypto dashboard built around liquidity: stop clusters, funding crowding and liquidation zones, with squeeze scanner, AI, alerts and journal. The decisions are yours.
ABOUT_DATA_SOURCE_PRICES_VALUE: Binance WebSocket + REST - 50 markets (majors, alts, memes, gold, S&P 500)
ABOUT_DATA_SOURCE_CRYPTO_NEWS_VALUE: Finnhub REST API + RSS (CoinDesk, CoinTelegraph, Decrypt, The Block)
ABOUT_DATA_SOURCE_ECON_CALENDAR_VALUE: Official US agency schedules (BLS, BEA, Census, Fed) + FRED
ABOUT_STEP1_TEXT: screens all 50 markets for crowded positioning. A score of 70+ flags a potential squeeze setup.
ABOUT_STEP2_TEXT: shows estimated liquidation zones and how dense each cluster is.
ABOUT_STEP3_TEXT: see which hours have historically had the thinnest trading volume.
ABOUT_STEP4_TEXT: get AI's read across dozens of live signals for a direct trade bias.
ABOUT_STEP5_TEXT: use the Position Sizer and Risk/Reward calculators before entering, so risk is defined before the trade.
ABOUT_STEP6_TEXT: use the Journal to record entry, exit, and reasoning, then check Signal Accuracy to see how past setups played out.
ABOUT_REMINDER_BODY: No warranties. All decisions are yours. The market does not care about your analysis.
ABOUT_CONTACT_BODY: Questions, support requests, or feedback: support@liquidity-hq.com

PRIVACY_SECTION_INFO_COLLECTED_BODY: We collect information you provide directly: email address and password when creating an account, and any preferences or settings you configure within the Platform. We also automatically collect usage data - pages visited, features used, session duration - and session recordings that replay your interactions with the Platform, in order to improve the service. See the Cookies and Tracking section below for what recordings capture and what is masked.
PRIVACY_SECTION_HOW_WE_USE_BODY: We use your information to operate and improve LiquidityHQ, authenticate your account, send service-related communications (such as account updates or security notices), and analyze usage patterns to prioritize features. We do not use your data to provide personalized investment advice.
PRIVACY_SECTION_DATA_STORAGE_BODY: Account data is stored securely via Supabase, a managed cloud database provider. We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest. No system is perfectly secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security of your data.
PRIVACY_SECTION_THIRD_PARTY_BODY: LiquidityHQ integrates with third-party services including Supabase (database), PostHog (product analytics and session recording), xAI Grok (AI analysis), Brevo (email delivery), Whop (payments), GlitchTip (error reports) and Cloudflare Turnstile (the bot check on the sign-in, sign-up and password reset forms). Telegram delivers the alerts you connect. Market and news data come from: Binance, Bybit, OKX and Hyperliquid (prices, funding rates, open interest, long/short ratios and liquidations); Coinbase (BTC premium); Deribit (BTC options); CoinMarketCap (BTC dominance); CoinGecko (all-time highs); SoSoValue (spot ETF flows); DefiLlama (stablecoin supply); blockchain.info (Bitcoin network data); Alternative.me (Fear & Greed index); Yahoo Finance (stock indices, gold, oil and the dollar index); ExchangeRate-API (currency rates); BLS, BEA, Census and the Federal Reserve (economic release schedules); FRED, St. Louis Federal Reserve (economic data); Finnhub and RSS feeds from news publishers (news). These providers have their own privacy policies and data practices. We are not responsible for their data handling.
PRIVACY_SECTION_COOKIES_BODY: We use session cookies necessary for authentication and platform functionality; these are always active because you cannot sign in without them. We also use PostHog, a third-party product-analytics service, which sets its own cookie and stores an identifier in your browser local storage in order to recognise returning sessions. PostHog captures usage events and session recordings - a replay of your interactions with the Platform, including pages viewed, clicks, and navigation. Analytics and session recording do not run unless you accept them when first asked, and you can turn them back off at any time under Settings, which stops collection immediately. Recordings mask all form inputs, and mask the contents of Trade Journal notes, thesis text, and profit-and-loss figures, so those values are not captured. We do not use advertising cookies and do not track you across other websites.
PRIVACY_SECTION_DATA_RETENTION_BODY: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. If you ask us to delete your account, we will remove your personal data from active systems within 30 days, except where retention is required by law or for legitimate business purposes such as fraud prevention.
PRIVACY_SECTION_SHARING_BODY: We do not sell your personal data. We do not share your data with third parties for marketing purposes. We may share data with service providers who assist in operating the Platform (e.g., hosting, analytics) under data processing agreements, and when required by law.
PRIVACY_SECTION_YOUR_RIGHTS_BODY: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data; to restrict or object to processing; and to data portability. To exercise these rights, contact us at the address below. We will respond within 30 days.

PRIVACY_SECTION_INTERNATIONAL_USERS_BODY: Your data may be transferred to and processed outside your own country by our hosting and service providers. By using the Platform, you consent to this transfer.

FAQ_INTRO: Answers to the questions we hear most - accounts, signals, alerts, and how LiquidityHQ works.
FAQ_Q_FREE_VS_PRO_Q: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
FAQ_Q_FREE_VS_PRO_A: Free covers the Dashboard, Briefing, News, Scanners, and full charting, plus a limited amount of AI analysis each day. Pro adds the faster timeframes, the Confluence Score, on-chain and macro data, Telegram alerts, up to 50 active price alerts, and a much larger AI allowance.
FAQ_Q_PRO_PRICE_A: $20 every 2 weeks, $49 a month, or $490 a year.
FAQ_Q_FREE_TRIAL_A: Yes. Every new account gets 14 days of full Pro access automatically, no card required. You're moved to the Free plan when the trial ends unless you upgrade.
FAQ_Q_CANCEL_PLAN_Q: How do I cancel or change my plan?
FAQ_Q_CANCEL_PLAN_A: Your subscription is billed through our payment processor. You can cancel anytime and you'll keep Pro access until the end of the period you already paid for - no partial refunds, no other action needed.
FAQ_Q_BUYSELL_SIGNAL_Q: What does a BUY or SELL signal mean?
FAQ_Q_BUYSELL_SIGNAL_A: It's the EMA ribbon strategy: a 9/20 EMA cross arms a direction, then the first candle that closes past the 50 EMA confirms it and prints the marker, with an entry, stop, and target shown. The same rule runs on the chart and in every alert. Extra indicators you add to the chart (RSI, MACD, etc.) are for your own reading and don't change what triggers an alert.
FAQ_Q_CONFLUENCE_SCORE_A: A Pro feature that combines the EMA ribbon, order flow, multi-timeframe RSI, choppiness, and RSI divergence into a single directional score, so you don't have to weigh five indicators yourself.
FAQ_Q_FINANCIAL_ADVICE_A: No. Everything on LiquidityHQ - signals, scores, alerts, and AI commentary - is for informational purposes only. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any asset, and we're not a registered investment advisor.
FAQ_Q_AI_DISAGREE_Q: Why might the AI say something different from the chart?
FAQ_Q_AI_DISAGREE_A: LiquidityAI can be incomplete or wrong, like any AI. Treat it as a second opinion, not the final word - always check it against the raw data on the chart.
FAQ_Q_TELEGRAM_SETUP_Q: How do I get Telegram alerts?
FAQ_Q_ALERT_MISMATCH_Q: Why didn't an alert match what's on the chart?
FAQ_Q_ALERT_MISMATCH_A: Alerts use the same fixed EMA ribbon signal engine as the Arena chart's own marker. If you've added extra chart indicators (RSI, MACD, SMA, etc.), those are just for your own reading and don't feed the alert engine, so an alert can look disconnected from whatever indicator you're currently viewing. If it still looks out of place, check the timeframe the alert was for - it may be describing an earlier candle than the one currently in view.
FAQ_Q_MUTE_ALERTS_A: Yes. On the Alerts page you can mute by coin, by direction, or by rule, so you only get pinged for what you actually care about.
FAQ_Q_ALERT_TF_CAP_Q: How many timeframes can I get alerts for?
FAQ_Q_ALERT_TF_CAP_A: Up to 3 at a time, picked from every timeframe the Arena chart itself offers. Switch them anytime from the Alerts page.
FAQ_Q_WHAT_IS_LHQ_A: Market intelligence for active crypto traders - one dashboard for price action, order flow, sentiment, and AI-assisted signals, instead of juggling a dozen tabs.
FAQ_Q_DATA_SOURCES_Q: Where does your data come from?
FAQ_Q_DATA_SOURCES_A: Price, funding, and open interest data comes from Binance and Bybit. News comes from Finnhub, and the Fear & Greed index comes from Alternative.me. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or availability of any third-party feed.
FAQ_Q_CUSTODY_Q: Do you have custody of my funds?
FAQ_Q_CUSTODY_A: No. LiquidityHQ is a read-only analytics and alerting tool - there's no wallet connection and we never touch or trade your funds.
FAQ_Q_WHO_FOR_A: Active and retail crypto traders who want one place to read the market and get notified when it moves, instead of stitching together TradingView, exchange apps, and a Telegram bot themselves.
FAQ_Q_TELEGRAM_SETUP_A: Telegram alerts are a Pro feature. Open the Alerts page and press Connect Telegram. You get a one-time code and two steps: open the bot, then send it the /start message shown on the page - there is a Copy button so you do not have to type it. The page updates itself the moment the bot receives it, and you never have to find or copy a chat ID.
REFUND_CALLOUT_BODY: This policy explains when payments to LiquidityHQ are, and are not, refundable. It does not cover trading or investment risk, which is addressed in our Full Disclaimer.
REFUND_SECTION_NO_REFUNDS_BODY: All payments to LiquidityHQ are final. We do not provide refunds, in full or in part, for any billing period once it has started - including if you cancel partway through, forget to cancel, or simply don't use the service.
REFUND_SECTION_CANCELLATION_BODY: You can cancel your Pro subscription at any time. Cancelling stops future billing but does not refund the current period - you keep full Pro access until the end of the period you already paid for, then your account moves to the Free plan.
REFUND_SECTION_FREE_TRIAL_BODY: Every new account gets a 14-day Pro trial with no card required, so you can evaluate the full product before paying anything. Because the trial itself is free, no refund applies to it - if you don't upgrade, your account simply moves to the Free plan when it ends.
REFUND_SECTION_BILLING_ERRORS_BODY: The one exception to our no-refund policy is a genuine billing error - for example, a duplicate charge, or a charge that went through after you'd already cancelled. Contact us and we'll investigate and correct any error we find.
REFUND_SECTION_CHARGEBACKS_BODY: If you have a billing concern, please contact us before filing a chargeback with your bank or card provider - most issues are resolved faster that way. Unwarranted chargebacks may result in your account being suspended.
REFUND_SECTION_CONTACT_BODY: For billing questions, cancellations, or a suspected billing error, contact support through the email on your purchase receipt. We aim to respond within 2 business days.
REFUND_FOOTER_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: By using LiquidityHQ, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to this Refund Policy.

HELP_INTRO: How each part of the platform works, in short. For what a term means, see the Glossary. For questions about plans and billing, see the FAQ.
HELP_Q_START_A: Create an account and open the Dashboard. Everything on the Free plan is available straight away, and the Pro features are unlocked for your first 14 days so you can see what they do before deciding.
HELP_Q_TRIAL_A: Full Pro access, with no card required: the faster timeframes, the Confluence Score, on-chain and macro data, Telegram alerts, up to 50 active price alerts, and the one-shot AI tools. Quick and Deep reads, chat and briefings have the same daily limits as the Free plan. When the 14 days end your account moves to the Free plan unless you upgrade.
HELP_Q_FIRST_LOOK_Q: What should I look at first?
HELP_Q_FIRST_LOOK_A: Start with the Setup Scanner, which screens all 50 markets for crowded positioning - a score of 70 or above flags a possible squeeze. Then open the Liquidation Map for the coin you are interested in, to see where the estimated liquidation zones sit and how dense each cluster is.
HELP_Q_READ_MARKER_Q: How do I read a buy or sell marker on the chart?
HELP_Q_READ_MARKER_A: It is the EMA ribbon strategy. A 9/20 EMA cross arms a direction, then the first candle that closes past the 50 EMA confirms it and prints the marker, with an entry, a stop and a target shown. The same rule runs on the chart and in every alert.
HELP_Q_CONFLUENCE_Q: How do I use the Confluence Score?
HELP_Q_CONFLUENCE_A: It is a Pro feature that combines the EMA ribbon, order flow, multi-timeframe RSI, choppiness and RSI divergence into one directional score, so you do not have to weigh five indicators yourself. Read it as how much those inputs agree, not as a forecast.
HELP_Q_OWN_INDICATORS_Q: I added RSI to the chart and my alerts did not change. Why?
HELP_Q_OWN_INDICATORS_A: Indicators you add to the chart are for your own reading. What triggers a marker or an alert is the EMA ribbon rule, and that does not change when you add or remove an indicator.
HELP_Q_SET_ALERTS_Q: How do I set up alerts?
HELP_Q_SET_ALERTS_A: Open the Alerts page. You can follow up to 3 timeframes at a time, picked from the same set the Arena chart offers, and you can switch them whenever you like.
HELP_Q_TELEGRAM_A: Telegram alerts are a Pro feature. Open the Alerts page and press Connect Telegram. You get a one-time code and two steps: open the bot, then send it the /start message shown on the page - there is a Copy button so you do not have to type it. The page updates itself the moment the bot receives it, and you never have to find a chat ID.
HELP_Q_MUTE_Q: How do I stop alerts I do not want?
HELP_Q_MUTE_A: On the Alerts page you can mute by coin, by direction, or by rule, so you are only pinged for what you care about.
HELP_Q_ARENA_WHAT_A: It reads dozens of live signals for the coin and timeframe you pick and gives you a direct trade bias, with the reasoning behind it. It is a reading of the data on screen, not a recommendation - the decision is still yours.
HELP_Q_AI_LIMIT_Q: Why has AI analysis stopped for today?
HELP_Q_AI_LIMIT_A: Every account has a daily AI allowance. Free gets a limited amount each day and Pro gets a much larger one. When you reach it, analysis resumes the next day.
HELP_Q_JOURNAL_A: Recording a trade: the entry, the exit, and the reasoning you had at the time. It is the part of the platform that keeps what you write yourself, so it is also where to put anything you want to keep.
HELP_Q_SIZING_Q: How do I size a position?
HELP_Q_SIZING_A: Use the Position Sizer and the Risk/Reward calculator before you enter, so the risk is defined before the trade rather than discovered after it.
HELP_Q_PASSWORD_Q: How do I change my password?
HELP_Q_PASSWORD_A: Settings, under Account. If you cannot sign in at all, use the reset link on the sign-in page instead.
HELP_Q_LANGUAGE_Q: Can I use LiquidityHQ in another language?
HELP_Q_LANGUAGE_A: Yes. Pick your language in Settings, under Language, or from the language switcher in the navigation. The choice is remembered on that device.
HELP_Q_THEME_Q: How do I switch between dark and light?
HELP_Q_THEME_A: There is a theme toggle in the navigation. Until you choose, the platform follows your system setting; after that it remembers your choice on that device.
HELP_STUCK_BODY: Write to support@liquidity-hq.com with the page and what you expected.
SECURITY_CALLOUT_BODY: Who operates LiquidityHQ, where your data is kept, who else handles it, and how to report a problem.
SECURITY_SECTION_OPERATOR_BODY: LiquidityHQ is built and run by an independent developer. The way to reach us is support@liquidity-hq.com, and it is read by the person who runs the service.
SECURITY_SECTION_WHERE_BODY: Your account and your saved data are held in a managed Postgres database run by Supabase. Your data may be processed outside your own country by that provider. The Privacy Policy covers that transfer.
SECURITY_SECTION_PROTECTION_BODY: Traffic between your browser and the platform is encrypted with TLS, and the database provider encrypts data at rest. Passwords are stored as a hash by the authentication provider, so nobody here can read yours. No system is perfectly secure and we do not claim otherwise.
SECURITY_SECTION_PROCESSORS_BODY: The full list - database, product analytics, AI analysis, email delivery, payments, and the market data and news feeds - is in the Privacy Policy, together with what each one is used for. It is kept in one place rather than repeated here, so the two cannot drift apart.
SECURITY_SECTION_FUNDS_TITLE: Your funds and your exchange account
SECURITY_SECTION_FUNDS_BODY: LiquidityHQ is a read-only analytics and alerting tool. There is no wallet connection and we never touch or trade your funds.
SECURITY_SECTION_ACCOUNT_BODY: Use a password you do not use anywhere else, and change it from Settings if you think it has been exposed. If you are locked out, the sign-in page has a reset link.
SECURITY_SECTION_REPORT_BODY: Write to support@liquidity-hq.com with enough detail for us to reproduce it, and please give us a chance to fix it before telling anyone else. One person reads that mailbox, so a plain description gets further than an automated scanner report.
A11Y_CALLOUT_BODY: What we aim for, what is in place today, where we know we fall short, and how to tell us when something blocks you.
A11Y_SECTION_SCOPE_BODY: This statement covers liquidity-hq.com and the platform served from it.
A11Y_SECTION_AIM_BODY: We work towards the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at Level AA and test against them as we build. That is what we measure ourselves against - it is not a certification, and nobody outside this project has audited it.
A11Y_SECTION_DONE_BODY: Visible keyboard focus indicators throughout. Dialogs keep keyboard focus inside them while they are open. Scores, grades and status chips carry text names, so a screen reader announces them rather than skipping past them. The platform works in dark and light, and honours a reduced-motion setting from your operating system.
A11Y_SECTION_LIMITS_TITLE: Where we know we fall short
A11Y_SECTION_LIMITS_BODY: The price and liquidation charts are visual by nature. The figures behind them appear as text elsewhere in the platform, but the chart drawing itself cannot be read by a screen reader. Some links, including those in the footer, are smaller than the minimum touch size the guidelines recommend. There is no skip-to-content link yet. And the platform has been tested by us, not by an outside accessibility specialist.
A11Y_SECTION_HELP_BODY: Write to support@liquidity-hq.com. Tell us which page, what you were trying to do, and what assistive technology you use. We will reply and say what we can do and roughly when.
REFUND_SECTION_EU_WITHDRAWAL_TITLE: EU customers: your right of withdrawal
REFUND_SECTION_EU_WITHDRAWAL_BODY: Consumers in the European Union normally have 14 days to withdraw from an online purchase without giving a reason. Digital services are treated differently: once you have asked for the service to start and it has been supplied, that right ends. Subscribing to LiquidityHQ gives you access to it, so for the period you are already in, the 14-day right will usually no longer apply. If you subscribed within the last 14 days and you believe the right still applies to you, write to support@liquidity-hq.com with your purchase details and we will deal with your case individually. Nothing in this policy removes a right that the law in your country gives you. This is our own plain-English summary of the rule.
